scenario: Angle conversion built-in functions per LEXP.3.6 — `degrees` converts radians to degrees (lowers to CLIPS `rad-deg`) and `radians` converts degrees to radians (lowers to `deg-rad`). Pin: both compile cleanly and lower to the expected CLIPS UDF names.
rules_ds:
from math import degrees, radians

schema Gyro scope logical:
    angle_rad: Float key
    angle_deg: Float mutable

rule r:
    Gyro g where degrees(g.angle_rad) > 45.0 and radians(g.angle_deg) < 1.0
->
    log info "ok"
